title: Cannot find a saved file
symptom: User cannot find a document they saved yesterday
user_description: I saved a proposal yesterday and now I can't find it anywhere. I don't remember which folder I used.

options.text: Tell him the file is deleted and he must start again
options.why: Wrong and unhelpful. Nobody has searched yet, so there is no reason to think the file is gone.

options.text: Restore the entire PC from a backup
options.why: Heavy-handed and risky. It could overwrite other work to find one file.

options.text: Search for the file name or a word from it in File Explorer, and check Recent files, Downloads and the app's recent list
options.why: Files are usually saved somewhere unexpected, such as Downloads or the last-used folder. Searching and checking recent lists finds most 'lost' files quickly.
A missing file is not a sign that Office is broken. This would waste time.

hints: What do you remember about the file, such as its name or when you saved it?
Where do programs often save files by default?
real_world_tip: Sort search results by date modified. Yesterday's file will be near the top.
